en: Welcome back. I take it you found the{SAUT}ammonite...
...Yeah, we did, but...
They're a little busy right now... Would{SAUT}you mind giving them a moment?
Busy?
I feel as though I am now one with the{SAUT}ancient world...{PAGE}I am the ammonite! The ammonite{SAUT}is me!
Absolutely... I know exactly what you{SAUT}mean Yusuke-kun! Viva ammonite!
......{PAGE}Please let me know when you are{SAUT}finished.
Sorry about this...
I'm starting to worry that we've lost{SAUT}the old Yuki-chan for good...
But aren't you excited to see{SAUT}Yukiko-chan's artwork? She'll finally{SAUT}be able to let her emotions flow.
Phew... I'd say it's not too bad. What{SAUT}about you, Amagi-san?
I drew one too!
Th-This is...!
An explosion.{OPTION}An ammonite?{OPTION}I'm not sure...
Yes, an explosion of imagination!{SAUT}A big bang of art!
The ammonite has left―no―burst{SAUT}through its shell... How wonderful!
Indeed. Such creativity has left me{SAUT}speechless as well... It's truly amazing!
No... I just followed your advice,{SAUT}Yusuke-kun.{PAGE}You taught me to let myself go... I'd{SAUT}never done anything like that before,{SAUT}but...{PAGE}I never thought it'd feel this good...
No... This was entirely your doing.{PAGE}...I must thank you.
Huh?

Drawing isn't simply about skill or{SAUT}knowledge...{PAGE}It is an art born from one's soul―from{SAUT}one's past experiences. It is these things{SAUT}that give rise to creativity...{PAGE}I had believed I was to teach you, but it{SAUT}appears you ended up teaching me.

Not at all. My art is nothing compared{SAUT}to yours.{PAGE}If it's okay with you, do you think I{SAUT}could have your picture?{PAGE}If I'm going to decorate the inn, I want{SAUT}something as expressive as this.
I'm honored to hear that.{PAGE}And may I ask you to give me your{SAUT}picture, Amagi-san?{PAGE}I want to remember the feeling of{SAUT}inspiration I had today.
Of course!
Did you two get to draw your pics?
Yeah! Look!
Whoa... That's really something...
Well, it's... definitely unique, but I think{SAUT}it's also kind of beautiful for that reason.{PAGE}You two seem to have really connected.
By working together, you got a double{SAUT}burst of creativity!
Yusuke-kun...!
Yes...! We may be able to use this in{SAUT}combat!
Ohh, there they go again.
To be on the same wavelength as Inari...{SAUT}She's got some real talent.
I would like to thank everyone.{PAGE}With this, the Phantom Thieves will now{SAUT}be even more powerful.
We're counting on you.{OPTION}Sounds good.
Leave it to me.
Oh, that's right. I promised I'd give you{SAUT}something in return.
Something in return?
Mhm. I was planning to cook something{SAUT}for Yusuke-kun as a way of saying{SAUT}thank you...
Why didn't you say so!? I'll help!
Th-That's probably...
A bad idea. Someone's gonna croak...
...If you're going to cook something,{SAUT}we'd like to pitch in as well.
Y-Yeah! If Yukiko-senpai wants to say{SAUT}thanks, then we'll help too!
Your friends are truly wonderful,{SAUT}Amagi-san.
Yeah! I'll have to work even harder for{SAUT}everyone from here on!
